format: Two 45-minute structured interviews plus a take-home work sample
panel: Senior analyst (SQL and data modelling, experimentation)

mustHaves.name: Work sample: correct SQL join and grain

decisionRule: Weighted average >= 3.0 on the 1-4 anchored scale AND all must-haves pass. The result is a recommendation to the hiring manager, not a hiring decision.

processChecks.accommodationRequested: Candidate B requested extra time for the work sample; granted under the organization's process.
processChecks.scoreEvidenceRule: At least one specific evidence note per competency score.

processIncidents.detail: Asked whether the candidate planned to have children soon.
processIncidents.requiredAction: Do not record or use the answer in scoring; escalate to the organization's HR/legal process; provide interviewer retraining.
